messages:
jess: Hey team — AcmeCorp's vendor risk asked for our pen-test report + vuln scan evidence + a remediation timeline. They want everything by EOD Wed. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-502. Can we provide redacted artifacts and committed fix dates?

maria: I can pull the POC artifacts. Do they want the raw scanner export (Qualys/Nessus) or just summarized CSV + PDF?

jess: They explicitly asked for 'pen test report, vulnerability scan evidence, and remediation timeline' so both the pen test PDF (redacted) and the scanner export (CSV) + remediation tracker.

dan: We can share a redacted pen-test PDF and the Qualys CSV export. Important: any HIGH/CRIT findings that aren’t fully remediated will need an InfoSec owner sign-off / risk acceptance. Proposed remediation plan: emergency patching for criticals (48–72h), highs scheduled next sprint, config mitigations within 2 weeks.

oli: I can own the runtime/high items. I'll create a tracker and add owners. Do we want to put artifacts on a read-only S3 link or a VDR?

maria: VDR is preferred (customer wants scoped access). Sales confirmed NDA is in place — jess can you re-confirm?

jess: Confirmed — NDA signed and attached in the ticket. I'll request VDR user access after we upload.

dan: I'll draft the cover note that accompanies the artifacts. It will include: CVE IDs, severity, evidence pointers (scanner output + screenshots), remediation owner, ETA, and whether a retest is required. Example CSV columns I’ll use: |cve|component|severity|status|owner|eta|retest_required|

maria: For pen-test redaction I'll run the PDF through qpdf to remove any embedded creds and then manual check. Code snippet I used earlier: ```bash
qpdf --password='' --decrypt pen_test_raw.pdf pen_test_decrypted.pdf
# then run redaction script that blanks email/api token lines
python tools/redact_pdf.py pen_test_decrypted.pdf pen_test_redacted.pdf
```

dan: Good. Note: any fix touching auth/session flows requires a retest after deploy — plan on adding 5 business days for verification in the tracker.

oli: Uploading Qualys CSV now to s3://redwood-vdr/acmecorp/vuln-scans/qualys-2025-08-14.csv (bucket ACL set to VDR-readonly). I'll also create a signed short-lived VDR link.

scanner-bot: Scan completed: Qualys VM scan finished 2025-08-14T03:12:08Z; findings summary -> total: 42, critical: 2, high: 5, medium: 18, low: 17. Export URL: s3://redwood-scanner-exports/qualys/qualys-2025-08-14.csv

jess: Perfect. Can we bundle a single zip with: pen_test_redacted.pdf, qualys-2025-08-14.csv, remediation-tracker.xlsx, and cover-note.md? Target is EOD Wed so I can share with AcmeCorp risk.

maria: Ack — I'll assemble the zip and ping legal for a final redaction check.

dan: I'll populate the tracker with owner emails and sign-off column. For the two criticals: scheduling emergency patch on Mon — ETA 48h after change window. I'll mark those as 'in-progress' and include rollback notes.

jess: Awesome — please post the VDR link here when ready and I’ll forward to the customer. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
